display.purpose: Page-level working titles — area and project headers. Caps at 1.43rem; the workspace never shouts.

title.purpose: Group headers — project names inside the Tasks tab, sub-area headings.

body.purpose: Default reading text; rows and titles typically run at 0.96rem.

label.purpose: Count pills, tag chips, badges — always tabular figures when numeric.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Modals and popovers only. Barely-there separation cue, never an elevation statement.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The drag-overlay preview exclusively — an object in the hand casts a shadow; an object at rest does not.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover washes, border-color shifts, input focus. State changes are near-instant; the instrument feels alive under the hand.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Progress-bar fills and other continuous value changes.

motion.name: focus-ring
motion.purpose: :focus-visible on every interactive element. Mouse focus stays clean; keyboard focus is always visible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most emphatic action on a screen — Iris fill, white text, one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #7c3aed); background: var(--accent, #7c3aed); color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #6d28d9); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #6d28d9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action — surface fill, hairline border; hover steps the surface up the ladder.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: inherit; font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #eae6f2); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f1ecfa); border-color: var(--border-strong, #d8d2e8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The row-level workhorse — transparent at rest, wakes with a surface wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: inherit; font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #4a4458); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f1ecfa); color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action — quiet danger border at rest; an armed confirm step flips to a solid danger fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font: inherit; font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--danger-border, #fda4af); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--danger, #e11d48); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-bg, #ffe4e6); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-danger-armed { background: var(--danger, #e11d48); border-color: var(--danger, #e11d48); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-danger-armed:hover { background: var(--danger, #e11d48); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Accent-wash pill for tags and metadata; muted variant for neutral counts.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.79rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--tag-border, #c4b5fd); background: var(--tag-bg, #ece6fb); color: var(--tag-fg, #6d28d9); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-muted { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-secondary, #4a4458); border-color: var(--border, #eae6f2); }

components.name: Sync Badge
components.description: The local-first story in plain words — always visible at the foot of the sidebar, never a toast.
components.html: Synced Syncing… Sync error
components.css: .ds-sync { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-secondary, #4a4458); padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #eae6f2); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sync-ok { color: var(--success, #10b981); background: var(--success-bg, #d1fae5); border-color: var(--success-border, #6ee7b7); } .ds-sync-warn { color: var(--warning, #d97706); background: var(--warning-bg, #fef3c7); border-color: var(--warning-border, #fcd34d); } .ds-sync-err { color: var(--danger, #e11d48); background: var(--danger-bg, #ffe4e6); border-color: var(--danger-border, #fda4af); }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: Area navigation row — transparent at rest, accent wash with Iris text when active, live count pill.
components.css: .ds-side-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.96rem; color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); background: transparent; border: 0; width: 100%; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s ease; } .ds-side-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f1ecfa); } .ds-side-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-side-row-active { background: var(--accent-bg, #ece6fb); color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); } .ds-side-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22a06b; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-side-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-side-count { font-size: 0.79rem; color: var(--text-muted, #9b96ae); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; min-width: 20px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-side-row-active .ds-side-count { background: var(--accent-tint, #e9e3fa); color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); }

components.name: Area Tab
components.description: Underline tab on a hairline baseline — active turns Iris with a 2px underline and tinted count pill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.57rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #eae6f2); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 2px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary, #4a4458); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: -1px; transition: color 0.1s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-border, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); } .ds-tab-count { font-size: 0.79rem; color: var(--text-muted, #9b96ae); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 999px; min-width: 18px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-count { background: var(--accent-tint, #e9e3fa); color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); }

components.name: Inline-Add Input
components.description: Signature creation affordance — a dashed invitation that solidifies into an Iris-bordered field on focus.
components.css: .ds-inline-add { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font: inherit; font-size: 0.93rem; color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--border, #eae6f2); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.1s ease, background 0.1s ease; } .ds-inline-add::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #9b96ae); font-style: italic; } .ds-inline-add:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted, #9b96ae); } .ds-inline-add:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); border-style: solid; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: The atomic unit — accent checkbox, inline-editable title, hover-revealed actions; done rows strike through and dim.
components.html:
Book the dentist appointment
Renew passport
components.css: .ds-task { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 0; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-task-check { width: 14px; height: 14px; cursor: pointer; accent-color: var(--accent, #7c3aed); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-task-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 0.96rem; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--text-h, #1f1b2e); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-task-done { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-task-done .ds-task-title { text-decoration: line-through; color: var(--text-muted, #9b96ae); }

narrative.overview: LocalAction is a precision tool for a solo power user running their whole life through it. Like a well-made instrument, it is quiet at rest and exact in the hand: calm surfaces, one voice of color, type that stays out of the way — and the moment you touch it, it responds with energized momentum. The system is built on restraint. One accent (Iris) carries every moment of emphasis across both themes; everything else is a violet-tinted neutral ladder. Depth comes from tonal layering, not drop shadows. Chrome is minimal by doctrine — the product's depth is demonstrated through polish and discoverability, never through stacked UI. Local-first ownership is visible, not hidden: the sync badge states its status in plain language at all times. The system explicitly rejects legacy enterprise PM feature walls and side-stripe banners (Asana/Jira), consumer-cutesy gradients and over-rounded cards, Evernote-era information clutter, and soulless gray-spreadsheet utilitarianism.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used sparingly — Iris appears on ≤10% of any screen
Tonal layering over shadows; surfaces are flat at rest
Quiet controls that wake on hover and focus
Inline-first editing — titles, inputs, and dates edit in place, not in dialogs
Density as a user knob (compact / normal / cozy), not a breakpoint strategy

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Iris is the only accent in the system, and it speaks on ≤10% of any given screen — one active row, one focused input, one primary action. Its rarity is the point. If two elements on a screen are competing in Iris, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Single Hue Family Rule
rules.body: Every neutral — canvas, surface, border, ink — is tinted toward ~293° violet. Never introduce warm grays or blue-grays; they read as dirt on this canvas.

rules.name: The User's Hues Rule
rules.body: Saturated non-violet hues exist only in the area palette, applied by the user, at dot scale. Never borrow them for system chrome.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter var everywhere. A second typeface in chrome is always a bug; alternate fonts ship only through the appearance menu.

rules.name: The Small Display Rule
rules.body: Display type caps at 1.43rem. Big hero type is for landing pages; this is a workspace. Emphasis comes from weight and the One Voice accent, never from shouting size.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadow appears on a static surface — not on cards, rows, buttons, or inputs. Depth is tonal. If a surface needs to stand out, step it up the ladder or give it a hairline, never a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Lift-Only-in-Motion Rule
rules.body: The 8px lift shadow exists only while dragging. When the drag ends, the shadow ends. Persistent lift is off-system.

dos: Do keep Iris on ≤10% of any screen (The One Voice Rule) — one active state, one primary action, one focused field.
Do express depth by stepping the neutral ladder (canvas → rail → surface → hover → active), never with shadows on static surfaces.
Do use tabular figures for any number that updates live — rollups, counts, progress.
Do make creation feel lightweight: dashed inline-add inputs at the point of work, not "New…" buttons that open dialogs.
Do keep the sync badge visible and plain-spoken — local-first ownership is a feature users can see.
Do preserve the 2px accent :focus-visible outline everywhere; the keyboard is a first-class surface.
Do size in rem so the density knob rescales everything.
donts: Don't build legacy enterprise PM feature walls or side-stripe banners (Asana/Jira) — no colored left borders on rows or callouts, no stacked chrome to advertise capability.
Don't go consumer cutesy: no gradients (and no gradient text), no radii beyond 14px on containers, no mascots or playful illustration.
Don't recreate Evernote-era clutter — density comes from the user's content, never from competing chrome; every view keeps one clear hierarchy.
Don't ship gray-spreadsheet utilitarianism — flat #808080-family grays, default browser controls, and unstyled tables are all off-system; the violet tint is the personality.
Don't introduce a second accent hue into chrome; non-violet hues belong only to the user's area dots.
Don't put drop shadows on cards, rows, or buttons at rest (The Flat-by-Default Rule); lift exists only while dragging.
Don't hide controls behind ellipsis menus when a hover-revealed icon or inline edit would do — but never reveal on hover what a keyboard user cannot reach.
Don't use display type above 1.43rem in the app shell (The Small Display Rule); the workspace never shouts.
